title: A static monitor and an instance monitor protect different reads
summary: One JVM worker writes under its class monitor. The caller’s lock and the worker’s explicit or implicit synchronized method determine whether five is protected.

subject.system: A static monitor and an instance monitor protect different reads

change.description: One JVM worker writes under its class monitor. The caller’s lock and the worker’s explicit or implicit synchronized method determine whether five is protected.

notes: The monitors JVM controls and both explicit checker entries run with python3 lib/benchmark/java-semantics-gap/campaign.py opening monitors.
The campaign's ordinary native checker decided 0/3 at opening and 0/3 at qualification, with 0 established and 0 refuted on original-JVM replays.

The separate schedule checker enumerated every completed sequentially consistent application-bytecode interleaving of the frozen two-thread callers, with successful start and join. Both class-matched callers returned true. The mixed caller returned both false and true, each reproduced on an original JVM.
